W3.rule: skip when a 3+-turn level lies within 0.25% ahead of the trade (15-min pivots, 4 bars each side)
fails: design: the arm no longer makes money

W2.rule: skip when a 2+-turn level lies within 0.25% ahead of the trade (15-min pivots, 4 bars each side)

B3.rule: skip unless the break crossed a 3+-turn level (15-min pivots, 4 bars each side)

W3M.rule: skip when a 3+-turn level lies within 0.25% ahead of the trade (major levels: 12 bars each side)
fails: design: the arm no longer makes money

B3M.rule: skip unless the break crossed a 3+-turn level (major levels: 12 bars each side)
fails: final: the arm no longer makes money

FX.rule: sell when a 5-minute bar closes back through the 3+-turn level the break crossed (fake breakout) (15-min pivots, 4 bars each side)
fails: design: the arm no longer makes money

FXM.rule: sell when a 5-minute bar closes back through the 3+-turn level the break crossed (fake breakout) (major levels: 12 bars each side)
